plan: Workers Paid, list prices with no allowance (the unit cost once the included usage is used up)
notes: A queue message is billed as three operations (write, read, delete) per 64 KB; each redelivery is one more read.
R2 egress is free; DeleteObject is free.
GB is decimal (1e9 bytes); TB is 1e12 bytes of plaintext.

Durable Objects (read 2026-11-21): a request is a WebSocket session opened or a request outside one; incoming WebSocket messages are billed 20 to 1 (the rig counts the close of a session as one). SQLite-backed storage: each put is billed as rows written. Duration (GB-s at 128 MB, only while an object cannot hibernate) is not measured by the native rig: report.py prices it from --cpu do_gb_s_per_request, measured on a deployed Worker.
